body:
Brings a teammate up to date quickly on everything that changed since they last applied a release.

### Each release
- When a release is made, Solace writes a **short** summary of its changes, built from the notes of the tasks it includes. Keeping it short matters most. There is no approval step.
- It also writes fuller details, but they show only when the person opens **show details**.
- The summary and details are shared with the project. Task notes stay private (D-261), so a teammate gets these two texts and never the notes themselves.

### Reading them
- A **Delivery** tab lists every release's summary, so past ones can be read at any time.
- When a teammate opens the project with releases they haven't read, they see one tab per unread summary, with a control to close them all. Each summary shows this way only once, and after that it lives in the Delivery tab.
- The summaries window has a **never show again** button, and the Settings area has a matching setting.

The release notes humans already ask for, edit and approve (feature:3637869b15413bc5) stay as they are.

Depends on: build: artifacts and versions (complete).
title: release: what's-new summaries for teammates
